issue_description: A heap buffer overflow write occurs during UTF-8 to UTF-32 conversion when the SIMD loop processes input too close to the end of the buffer. The safety margin derived from trailing leading-byte counting is too small, so malformed UTF-8 near the end of the input can reach `convert_masked_utf8_to_utf32` without enough reserved space and cause writes past the end of the UTF-32 output buffer.
